name: Coding Agents
description: I am trying to build a kind of framework around OSS-CODE, the idea is to build an app-like experience that links up multiple LLMs, all free ones. The plan is to assign an LLM to one task, each of the LLM has a specific core speciality it is trained in. There is one "context window" which automatically assigns the jobs to each of the indivdual agents their jobs when a user types in a prompt.
